title: Bring Up Operator-Authenticated Proof Review Surface
description: Operator lifecycle command that opens the ADR 0015 staging proof-cockpit /proof gate on the running composed public proof edge (external-caddy) behind an HTTP basic-authentication operator credential.
purpose: Let the accountable operator open the /proof cockpit gate on the shared composed Caddy edge (brought up first by the caddy-up prerequisite) by writing a reload-managed operator-authenticated include and starting the compose-network-only staging-proof-cockpit service in write mode, then reach the human proof review, bulk acceptance, and signoff controls at the staging FQDN /proof, prompting for the operator credential at invocation.
outputs: Running staging-proof-cockpit Compose service reachable only over the compose network as staging-proof-cockpit:8080
An operator-authenticated /proof gate include written to the gitignored runtime mount and loaded via a Caddy reload on the running external-caddy edge
Fail-closed verification status codes (no-credential 401, operator-credential 200) and the review URL on standard output
sideEffects: Requires the composed public proof edge to be up first (the caddy-up Make prerequisite); the edge itself needs no operator credential
Prompts for an operator username and password and hashes the password with the Caddy image
Writes an operator-authenticated /proof gate include (basic_auth plus reverse_proxy) to the gitignored .proof-review/caddy runtime mount, never committed
Generates a fresh USF_PROOF_COCKPIT_REVIEW_SECRET for the session and enables cockpit write mode; an unset secret leaves the cockpit read-only
Seeds the acceptance ledger Docker volume from the committed evidence corpus on first run only
Starts the staging-proof-cockpit Compose service and reloads external-caddy to open the /proof gate
failureSemantics: Fails closed if Docker is unavailable, the staging Compose file is missing, the composed edge is not running, or the credential is empty; if the fail-closed verification does not observe a 401 without credentials the gate is closed (503 default restored) and the cockpit is torn down. A failed bring-up records no acceptance and leaves no unauthenticated surface. This command does not itself accept or sign off anything and upgrades no readiness claim.
aiGuidance: Use this command to open the operator-authenticated /proof gate on the shared composed proof edge per ADR 0015. It depends on caddy-up (the shared public edge, which needs no credential), then writes a reload-managed operator basic-authentication include in front of the compose-network-only cockpit; do not remove the authentication gate or the cockpit write guard, do not bake operator credentials into the caddy service environment, and do not treat a running review surface as a staging, deployment, production, or product-UI readiness claim.
